facts.fact: The Algerian Interior Ministry's digitisation of the national civil-status register has digitised more than 100 million marriage, death and birth acts, per La Sentinelle.

The Ministry of the Interior says a computerised civil-status system and a centralised database, the Registre National d'Etat Civil (RNEC), were set up in an operation launched in 2010, with birth-record registers archived digitally.

note: Civil status is named only as a database to be centralised, no register system described.

facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list completeness of birth registration in Algeria at 99.6% for 2019, a national rate not tied to a digital system.

The World Bank's SPI lists Algeria as meeting SDG 17.19.2, birth registration at least 90% and death registration at least 75% complete, in its 2024 round; no digital system is tied to it and the year is the survey round's.
